# Vibemaster

> Vibemaster is an AI-powered workspace that turns a product idea into a structured, buildable specification that AI coding tools can follow.

## What is Vibemaster?

Most people can't describe what they want to build — that's why AI builders fail. Vibemaster bridges the gap between a product idea and the technical instructions AI coding tools need. It interviews founders, product managers and developers about their idea and produces a complete specification: product structure, user flows, data model, architecture and a build prompt.

The output works directly with AI builders such as Lovable, Cursor, Bolt.new, Replit, Google AI Studio and Claude Code — without vague prompts or broken builds. Vibemaster does not build the product itself; it writes the "recipe" the AI tools build from.

## Who is it for?

- Non-technical founders, operators and creators who want to build digital products
- Product managers who need clear technical specifications
- Developers who want a structured architecture before building

## What does Vibemaster produce?

- Four documents: spec, user flows, data model and a build prompt
- The architecture as an interactive flowchart
- A code prompt that is a real specification: architecture, setup files for your coding tool, and what to build in which order
- Two paths in every plan: traditional development vs vibe coding

## How it works

1. Describe your idea in plain language
2. Vibemaster interviews you — step by step, or in conversation mode where it asks follow-ups on what you actually say
3. You get a complete, structured specification to paste into your AI builder of choice

## What's new in Vibemaster 2.0

- Conversation mode: an AI-led interview (included in Professional)
- Two AI models, chosen per session: Gemini (default) or Mistral (European)
- The architecture as a flowchart that founders, developers, investors and customers can discuss together
- A richer code prompt with architecture and setup files
- Search and replace across all documents, no lost sessions, rebuilt for phone and tablet
- The whole app in English and Swedish

## Pricing

- Free (€0): 2 projects with no time limit, all four documents plus the architecture flowchart, Gemini or Mistral
- Professional (€11.95/month, or €119.50/year): unlimited projects, conversation mode, priority 24/7 support. BYOK (Bring Your Own API Key) coming soon.
- Team (€51.95/month, coming soon): up to 5 seats, shared projects, full API access
- Enterprise: custom pricing, dedicated support

## Technology & Compliance

- Hosted in the EU (Scalingo, Paris, France)
- GDPR compliant — data stays within EU jurisdiction
- Only anonymized material is used to train AI models; users keep full control over their content
